author: Carl Sandburg
title: Rootabaga Stories
edition: PG transcription of the Harcourt, Brace and Company, New York, original-English text, copyright 1922 (copyright leaf: "Copyright, 1922, by Harcourt, Brace and Company, Inc."; printed by the Quinn & Boden Company, Rahway, N. J.); printing undated. Project Gutenberg 27085 HTML, made from Rosetta Project scans. Paragraph boundaries retained; prose line-wrap whitespace folded; italic emphasis rendered as plain text; page numbers, illustrations, captions, the Petershams' decorations and the book's numbered section-group headings are excluded.

rights.basis: The transcription reproduces the publisher title page and the 1922 Harcourt, Brace copyright leaf of this original-English text. Works published in the United States in 1922 entered the US public domain no later than 1 January 2018; the Project Gutenberg 27085 catalogue explicitly labels the text public domain in the USA. Only Sandburg's 1922 story text is supplied; the Petershams' illustrations are not reproduced.

acquisition.method: Downloaded Project Gutenberg HTML pg27085-images.html from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror of the Gutenberg cache and converted with a scratch HTML parser: h1–h6 become headings, p elements paragraphs, stanza divs and br-broken lines stanzas (one line per printed line, indentation dropped), HTML entities decoded, inline emphasis rendered as plain text, prose whitespace folded to single spaces. Omitted throughout: the Project Gutenberg header, footer and licence, page-number anchors, illustrations and their captions, the title page, copyright leaf, contents and list of full-page illustrations. Kept: the dedication (joined as one stanza), the eight numbered section-group titles as headings, each group's list of "People" as tab-separated table rows, and every story.
